title: WPCRL/1142/2012 of RAJESH KUMAR AND ANR Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND AND ORS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Criminal Writ Petition No.1142 of 2012
1. Rajesh Kumar
2. Aslam
 ÖÖÖ..Petitioners
Versus
State of Uttarakhand & others
ÖÖÖRespondents
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
 Mr. Tanuj Semwal, Advocate, for the petitioners.
 Mr. K.S. Rautela, AGA for the State/respondent nos.1
and 2.
 Having heard the learned counsel, it appears that the
petitioners promised for execution of sale deed of a residential
house in Dehradun in favour of complainant/respondent no.3
and in lieu thereof, they took a consideration of Rs.26.00 lakh
(Rs.20.00 lakh by Cheques which they got encashed from the
Bank and Rs.4.00 lakh in cash).
 Respondent No.3 is a septuagenarian and thus, is unable
to face the petitioners in the litigation. In fact, the petitioners
did not own the house, in question, but they were simply the
mediators, rather the house was owned by a person based at
Lucknow.
 When the sale deed could not be executed, complainant
demanded his money back but instead of returning the
money, the petitioners threatened and intimated him to the
extent of killing him by life.

The Court feels that such type of accused do not deserve
any sympathy by this Court. The petition is thus, bereft of
any merit and liable to be dismissed at the threshold. Petition
is dismissed accordingly.
(Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.)
02.01.2013
Rdang
